'''Jason Myra''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Red 113 from Flushing, NY. The slot was marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="smlist" />

[[File:Jason Myra Times Square 1999.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Myra in Times Square, New York, 1999]]
